messages:
Tom (AE): Summit Health wants a short POC to validate SAML + SCIM + delegated admin flows. Key asks: Azure AD + Okta, domain verification (DNS TXT), nested groups, and deprovisioning behavior. Can we do a 3-day test next week?
Iris (SE): Yes. SCIM v2 push works. We need IdP metadata and a test Azure AD tenant. Note: enable incremental sync for >2k groups.
Iris (SE): SCIM snippet we send:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{
  "userName": "jane@summit.com"
}
Nadia (Security): From questionnaire: please provide IdP metadata, SCIM endpoint, expected daily sync ops, whether PII will be provisioned, and IP ranges for allowlist. We default to 90d audit retention.
Ben (Pricing): Hosted plan includes SCIM up to 5k ops/day. Over that we charge per-sync overage or provisioning add-on. Delegated admin included on enterprise tier. Need MAU to quote.
Hana (Solutions): Proposed POC plan: 1) collect metadata 2) do full SCIM for 200 users + 3 groups 3) test group->role mapping and delegated admin scope 4) verify domain TXT and reject unverified domains. Target Fri for wrap.
Tom (AE): I'll ask them to share metadata and staging creds. Assign: Iris -> run SCIM; Nadia -> sec answers; Ben -> delta quote; Hana -> runbook. Meeting: Thu 11am PT.
Iris (SE): One caveat: if they use email aliases enable email_normalization. Also we support deprovision webhook on Dedicated deployments.
Nadia (Security): I'll draft the questionnaire answers and cert rotation notes by EOD Wed.
Ben (Pricing): I'll post a ballpark in 2 hours.
Tom (AE): Thanks all, will update once I have metadata. :thumbsup:
